title: Check: Effect of Catalysts on Rate (B)

questions.stem: Manganese dioxide (MnO₂) catalyses the decomposition of hydrogen peroxide. Which of the following is true about the MnO₂?

options.text: It changes the products formed in the reaction
It can be recovered unchanged at the end of the reaction
It is used up during the reaction and must be replaced
It changes the enthalpy change of the reaction

questions.explanation: A defining feature of a catalyst is that it is not used up during the reaction. The MnO₂ can be recovered by filtration after the reaction is complete, and its mass will be unchanged. It does not alter the products formed or the enthalpy change.
